text: Bring all your coding agent sessions together. Visualize them in a graph and compare with your friends. Fully local and private. SessionGraph reads your harness' session store, indexes it and opens a desktop app for you to play around. Everything happens locally. Paste this into your terminal to open SessionGraph. Prefer installer? Search across your harnesses from one local index. Find an old conversation, pick up where you left off, or look up what changed. “Find my sessions about invoice retries.” Find sessions about invoice retries over HTTP.
